project_type: React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript 5.6 + Tailwind CSS v3.4 SPA
build_system: Vite 5 with npm. Run from d:\scout system\frontend. vite.config.ts needs proxy added: /api → http://127.0.0.1:8000, /media → http://127.0.0.1:8000
test_framework: No unit test framework currently — verification is via npm run build (tsc -b && vite build).
verification_instructions: Run 'cd d:\scout system\frontend && npm run build' — must complete with 0 TypeScript errors and 0 Vite build errors.
environment_constraints: RTL direction is set globally in tokens.css (html { direction: rtl }). Do NOT use margin-left/right — use ms-/me- for RTL-safe spacing. No hardcoded hex colors — use CSS custom properties via Tailwind token classes (bg-surface, text-gold-400, etc). zustand is NOT yet installed — run 'npm install zustand@^4.5.5' first. All other dependencies (react-router-dom, recharts, axios, @tanstack/react-query, zod, react-hook-form, @radix-ui/*, lucide-react, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge) are already installed.
contribution_requirements: Use cva + cn pattern (see existing Button.tsx/Badge.tsx/Input.tsx). All colors via CSS vars from tokens.css. All forms use react-hook-form + zod. All API calls via api/client.ts axios instance. No TypeScript 'any' without justification. Use RTL-safe Tailwind utilities.
key_patterns: Existing UI components (Button/Badge/Input) use cva from class-variance-authority + cn from lib/utils.ts. CSS custom properties defined in src/styles/tokens.css and mapped in tailwind.config.js. Sidebar layout uses CSS vars --sidebar-width/--sidebar-collapsed from tokens.css. Class 'layout-main' and 'sidebar-collapsed' defined in tokens.css. Font is Cairo (self-hosted, RTL Arabic). @radix-ui/* primitives are already installed for Dialog/Select/Tabs/Avatar/etc.
directory_structure: frontend/src/components/ui/ — existing Button/Badge/Input + new Card/Table/Dialog/Select/Spinner/Pagination. frontend/src/components/layout/ — new Sidebar/Topbar/MainLayout. frontend/src/components/shared/ — new LoadingSpinner/EmptyState/ConfirmDialog/AvatarWithFallback. frontend/src/pages/ — auth/dashboard/members/structure/users. frontend/src/api/ — client/auth/members/structure/users. frontend/src/store/ — authStore. frontend/src/hooks/ — useAuth/usePermission/useDebounce/usePagination. frontend/src/types/ — index.ts. frontend/src/utils/ — formatDate/formatCode. frontend/src/styles/tokens.css — DO NOT MODIFY.
